country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Avonmouth Data Centre
notes: Planning-screening request to Bristol City Council describes change of use of the former polymers recycling facility at Viridor Avonmouth ERF, Severn Road, Avonmouth, Bristol BS11 0YL for use as a data centre. Trade reports and directory listings describe the first Viridor/Rivington EfW-powered project as a proposed/planned 40 MW AI-ready facility, potentially operational in 2027.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City of Kingston upon Hull
name: KCOM Hull City Centre Data Centre
notes: KCOM markets colocation from its Hull city centre Tier 2 data centre with secure cabinets, dual power, cooling, backup generators, and remote hands. Capacity not publicly stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Easyspace / iomart Leicester Data Centre
notes: Easyspace/iomart says its Leicester data centre is one kilometre north-west of the city, with 620 sq m across two data halls, carrier-neutral connectivity, dual feeds, UPS and diesel generators. Public pages cite generator/UPS ratings rather than an IT load figure, so capacity_mw is left null.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Deep Green DG02 York
notes: Deep Green's York pipeline site is described as DG02 at/near Monks Cross/LNER Community Stadium, with waste heat intended for local heat users. Linked public posts cite 500 kW capacity and RFS in 2026/early 2027; City of York Council asset papers note a Community Stadium data centre proposal and lease/heat benefits.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Goonhilly Earth Station Data Centre
notes: Goonhilly says its Earth Station HQ at Goonhilly Downs, Helston, is home to Cornwall's only data centre and provides scalable colocation with redundant power, CRAC cooling, fire detection/suppression and fibre links to London. Capacity not publicly stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: ITPS Angel House Data Centre
notes: ITPS lists its Chester-le-Street, County Durham address and data-centre services; third-party colocation records identify Angel House as a 33,000 sq ft, 2 MW colocation/enterprise data centre. Older industry coverage reports Keysource upgrade/expansion work at ITPS's County Durham colocation facility.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Mill Hill County Durham Data Centre Power Project
notes: AVK-SEG's October 2025 release says the UK project pipeline for data-centre-focused low-carbon behind-the-meter power includes a 30 MW consented site at Mill Hill, County Durham. Public evidence is strongest for power/microgrid infrastructure serving data centres rather than naming the end data centre operator.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Hawthorn Pit Data Centre and BESS Hybrid Project
notes: DCD reports Innova submitted data centre projects through NESO queue reforms, including a 500 MW hybrid data-centre/BESS facility at Hawthorn Pit, County Durham. Treated as planned/submitted grid-queue proposal; no local planning consent found in this pass.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: UK Servers Continuity House Datacentre
notes: UK Servers says Continuity House in Coventry opened at the start of 2023 after a ground-up build, with 20,000 sq ft, initial 300 racks, 3 MW onsite power from diverse 11 kV supplies and 4 MW backup generation.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: UK Servers 211 Coventry Datacentre
notes: UK Servers says its 211 Coventry datacentre opened in December 2011, with 80 racks across two data halls, N+1 UPS, 32A maximum load per rack and 2 x 375 kVA generators. No MW IT load stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pioneer Park Clean Energy and AI Data Centre Campus
developer: BEC / Energy Coast West Cumbria Ltd; Cumberland Council; Nuclear Decommissioning Authority
notes: BEC's Pioneer Park master-planning tender/prospectus describes land near Sellafield in West Cumbria being explored for clean energy development and AI/data centre infrastructure, including direct-line power supply to AI data centre facilities by 2030. NDA announced funding for a masterplan examining how clean energy and AI/data centre infrastructure could come together. No firm data-centre MW allocation found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Node4 Derby Data Centre
notes: Node4 says its Derby data centre has 16,000 sq ft, four data halls, 330 rack capacity and Tier 2+ standard. Node4 lists 2.5 MVA power split across two buildings; third-party directory also reports 2.5 MW total power.
